implementation_strategy: Execute paired confirmatory run using hosted-model API (gpt-5-mini) for both conditions; retrieval/embedding and proposer calls performed via the hosted provider; deterministic Dockerized verifier/simulator (Batfish-style) invoked locally in Docker; all scoring and flagging automated. No human labour.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic stratified snapshot (4 topology families × 3 protocol scenarios distribution; 8 cells×17 tasks + 4 cells×16 tasks = 200). Manifest hashed and published prior to execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 prompt templates and schema. Guarded: RAG retrieval (embedding index) + proposer + deterministic parse + verifier + single automated repair iteration. All templates and seeds snapshot-hashed prior to execution.
execution_batches: batch-1: Paired execution of tasks 1–200; for each task run baseline and guarded episodes sequentially to preserve pairing and deterministic logs.
randomisation_plan: No random allocation across conditions (paired within-task). Deterministic RNG seeds used for any stochastic components; seeds snapshot-published.
caching_plan: Provider-hosted embedding and generation caches disabled; local deterministic retrieval index served from published snapshot. Intermediate Docker verifier caches persisted between episodes to reduce startup overhead.
failure_recovery_plan: One automatic retry per task on transient API/infrastructure failures. Persistent failures -> deterministic exclusion and reporting per preregistered exclusion rules. All failures logged with hashes.
result_schema: Each episode record: {task_id, condition, model_name, model_version, prompt_hash, retrieval_doc_hashes, generated_config, parse_status, verifier_result (critical_error:boolean, failure_codes:list), sandbox_reachability_matrix, latency_ms, output_hash}. Paired-analysis file aggregates per-task baseline vs guarded.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls = task_count * 2 = 200*2 = 400 (one model call per episode per adapter contract). Dockerized verifier runs locally (CPU only) per episode; CPU resources sufficient under capability manifest; wall-clock budget 7 days. No local GPU required.
